verdict.rationale: Paystack is a payments API and dashboard, not an AI agent or host application that consumes tools. Plugging MCP servers in as a client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any agent or assistant feature that could act as an MCP client, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
